biological_reference.closest_mechanism: General cognitive-map / world-model representations (hippocampal/parietal allocentric maps) are known NOT to automatically carry every behaviourally-relevant gradient signal; dedicated parallel pathways (mesolimbic value coding, hypothalamic interoceptive/homeostatic signalling) carry resource- and reward-relevant gradients that a general spatial world-model does not guarantee to preserve.
dependencies: a specialised resource/value channel distinct from the general world-model latent
biological_reference.divergence: None -- this finding CORROBORATES, rather than diverges from, REE's own prior biologically-motivated architecture decisions: SD-010/SD-011 (splitting one z_world stream into z_self/z_world/z_harm_s on biological grounds) and SD-015 (a dedicated z_resource encoder, built specifically because z_world alone was not adequate for goal-directed resource seeding). 948 is a second, independent demonstration of the same general principle via a different symptom (external-actor foraging competence rather than z_goal cosine alignment).
biological_reference.lit_status: present (via the SD-010/SD-011/SD-015 architecture rationale and design docs; no new /lit-pull needed for this specific finding -- it replicates an already-lit-grounded REE design principle rather than importing an ungrounded formal construct)

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: RED-TEAM-CORRECTED (redteam_948.md): SD-018 ('encoder.resource_proximity_supervision') was NOT absent from this run -- latent.use_resource_proximity_head=true was already active in the shared base config for the whole x734/737/808/948 family (ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_724_competence_localization_diagnostic.py:338; loss wired at ree_core/agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss). So 948's finding is sharper than 'z_world has no resource supervision': it is 'z_world, even WITH SD-018's scalar resource-proximity auxiliary loss already training it, still does not expose enough structure for a downstream PPO reader to clear the D3 competence floor' (ppo_ree_latent 0.5 res/ep vs a 1.0 floor). SD-018 supervises a SCALAR target (max(resource_field_view) -- magnitude only); 948's positive arm succeeds by exposing the FULL 25-dim field (direction + magnitude). Plausible read: a scalar proximity signal cannot tell a policy WHICH WAY to move; foraging needs the directional gradient SD-018 was never designed to supply. Recommend SD-018's target be extended/re-scoped from a scalar regression (benefit_eval_r2 > 0.5 against max(resource_field_view)) to a richer directional readout, OR that the raw field be routed as an explicit additional channel alongside z_world (mirroring what worked here) rather than relying solely on scalar auxiliary supervision. SEPARATE, SECONDARY FINDING for governance: SD-018's own metric_trajectory carries only its PRE-implementation baseline (r2=-0.004, EXQ-085m) and no post-implementation validation entry at all despite implementation_status:implemented since 2026-04-07 -- it is not established SD-018 ever met its own r2>0.5 bar. CROSS-REFERENCE (secondary, more tangential): SD-015 ('Dedicated z_resource encoder for goal-directed navigation') targets a related but distinct consumer (z_goal cosine-seeding for MECH-112 wanting/liking, not general downstream foraging competence) and its own 2026-04-14 record found z_world unexpectedly OUTPERFORMING z_resource for goal alignment, leaving an 'action-selection integration' bottleneck open. Governance should judge SD-018-amend (primary recommendation, same encoder module and same resource_field_view content) vs SD-015-amend vs a new entry; this autopsy presents the options rather than silently picking one.

failure_record_entry.target: a downstream reader of z_world (under SD-018's existing scalar proximity supervision, or an extended/richer version of it) should clear the 1.0 D3 competence floor on a strict majority of seeds

learning_extracted: The REE z_world encoder discards recoverable, independently-certified-sufficient resource-gradient structure that is present in its own raw input (world_state) -- a concrete, NAMED, actionable representational gap, not an unspecified 'substrate ceiling'.

This CONFIRMS the H-observation-interface leg of the conversion_ceiling_root hypothesis-space question as a positive, sufficient demonstration (not merely the negative/necessary result V3-EXQ-813 supplied), while explicitly NOT eliminating H-substrate-ceiling or H-f-dominance -- the design does not test those legs.

RED-TEAM-SHARPENED: SD-018's resource-proximity auxiliary supervision (latent.use_resource_proximity_head=true) was already ACTIVE in this run's base config -- this is not a 'z_world has zero resource supervision' finding, it is 'z_world's existing SCALAR resource-proximity signal (SD-018) is insufficient; the full DIRECTIONAL 25-dim field is what actually restores competence.' Also surfaces that SD-018's own post-implementation validation was apparently never recorded despite being marked implemented since 2026-04-07.

The finding also parallels, more loosely, the still-open 'action-selection integration' blocker on SD-015's z_resource encoder (a different consumer -- z_goal cosine-seeding, not general foraging competence) -- two independent lines of evidence point at the same broader class of gap: resource-relevant information exists in the substrate but is not fully reaching the pathway that needs it to act.

The indexer's automatic vacuous_pass adjudication flag on this run is a FALSE POSITIVE, structurally analogous to the V3-EXQ-783/830/906/908 precedents already documented in build_experiment_indexes.py's own docstring: the driver tags all four criteria load_bearing:true, but its own combination_rule states the PASS is carried by exactly ONE of them (C_latent_plus_localfield_clears_floor) while the other three -- including the one reading passed:false -- are REPLICATION ANCHORS whose values SELECT the interpretation label rather than gating PASS/FAIL. This is a genuinely new 5th sub-case (a load_bearing:true criterion that is an anchor EXPECTED to read false by design, not a caveat the author separately marked load_bearing:false) and is worth a small indexer fix, but is out of this autopsy's charter to make.
